gtcsolo.industrial_chemical_bath.introdu: A chemical bath for bulk washing and chemical treatment. Fit a fluid input hatch in the watertight casing to supply the required liquid.
Processing time is reduced by 15%. Supports Industrial Overclocking. Parallel hatches are unavailable.
gtcsolo.heating_chamber.introduction.1: A large extractor suited to melting metal in bulk. Collect molten metal from the fluid output hatch.
gtcsolo.heating_chamber.introduction.2: Before overclocking, it processes 16 batches in four times the duration of a standard operation.
